title: GHMC trade licences: renew by Nov 30 or pay up to 100% penalty

slides.head: GHMC trade licences: renew by Nov 30 or pay up to 100% penalty
What happened
slides.body: Shops and businesses inside GHMC limits must renew 2027 trade licences by Nov 30 to avoid penalties.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Renewals must be filed in the 30-day window before the licence expires on Dec 31.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: Trading without a valid licence draws a 100% penalty plus an extra 10% fine every month.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Whether GHMC extends the Nov 30 penalty-free window, as traders often ask. Ask: How many GHMC businesses renew late each year?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
GHMC trade licences: renew by Nov 30 or pay up to 100% penalty

GHMC Commissioner R.V. Karnan said on Nov 20 that 2026 trade licences stay valid until Dec 31, 2026, but 2027 renewals filed by Nov 30 carry no penalty. Late renewals from Dec 1 attract 25%, and from Feb 1, 2027, 50%.

Why it matters: Renewals must be filed in the 30-day window before the licence expires on Dec 31.

Source: Telangana Today. Image: Telangana Today
